newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Bang resumes trading after placement.
newsitem.headline: Dah Bang resumes trading after placement.

text.p: Trading in shares and warrants of Dah Bang (Holdings) Ltd will resume on Monday on completion of shares and warrants placements, resulting in the public stake rising above the stock exchange requirement level of 25 percent.

The printing machinery distributor said Golik Investments Ltd had placed 24.87 million shares and 5.85 million warrants, representing a respective 12.44 percent and 14.62 percent of its share capital and outstanding warrants, at HK$0.95 per share and HK$0.125 per warrant to third parties.

Upon completion, Golik and Dah Bang's directors would hold 73.07 percent of Dah Bang's share capital, and 72.50 percent of the outstanding warrants, down from a previous 85.51 percent of shares and 87.12 percent of warrants.
The public's holding of shares and warrants will be raised to a respective 26.93 percent and 27.50 percent, it said.
